about_the_game:
Welcome to Beach Bar Simulator, a relaxing yet challenging management simulation set on the beautiful shores of Miami Beach. Take charge of your own beach bar, serve customers, manage resources, and grow your business from a small shack to a thriving hotspot!

Features:

🛠️ Single & Co-op Mode – Enjoy the game solo or team up with a friend in online co-op!
🍹 Realistic Bar Management – Prepare drinks, serve customers, and keep them happy.
🏝️ Customize & Expand – Design your bar, upgrade equipment, and create the perfect beach vibe.
💰 Economy & Strategy – Balance your budget, set prices, and make smart business decisions.
🎯 Customer Reactions – Serve the right drinks and keep customers satisfied with your service.

Can you turn your small beach bar into a world-famous destination? It’s time to mix, serve, and manage your way to success!

content_descriptors.notes: Beach Bar Simulator contains themes of alcohol and social interactions. The game may feature some adult-oriented themes, but does not contain explicit sexual content, excessive violence, or drug use. Players will engage with bar management, customer relationships, and social interactions
